_comment: pathTranslators has NO environment variable equivalent and can only be
set in this file. Tdarr imports library paths verbatim from Radarr and
Sonarr, which report Windows paths that do not exist inside the
container. Without translators, every library imports zero files and the
queue stays empty with no error.
Backslashes in JSON must be escaped as \\. Adjust the server values if
your Windows media paths change. The node values must match the container
To apply: stop the container, edit the generated config in place, start
the container. Tdarr rewrites this file on start, so editing it while the
container is running will lose your changes.
